subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: Should compact Control UI run progress be implemented directly in the Control UI now, or should it wait for the broader gateway/session activity API tracked by the related session-activity issues and PRs?
rationale: The requested UI depends on what activity state the gateway should expose, and related open work proposes competing API and UX boundaries.

options.title: Use canonical session-activity API first
options.body: Land or design the gateway-owned session activity contract first, then render compact Control UI progress from that stable source.

options.title: Ship a Control UI-only strip
options.body: Add a narrower UI projection from existing coarse state now, accepting that it may need rework when session activity semantics settle.

options.title: Defer behind broader activity work
options.body: Keep this issue linked as the Control UI acceptance target while the broader API issue owns gateway semantics.

recommendation.title: Use canonical session-activity API first
recommendation.body: Land or design the gateway-owned session activity contract first, then render compact Control UI progress from that stable source.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest shortlog signal across the relevant UI/gateway/session surfaces and recent adjacent changes.
